F1: contents` is now `display: flex` (header.scss:17). Because `header-extra-info` sets no `tagName`, its `div.ember-view` wrapper is the flex item, and nothing gives it `min-width: 0`. It can't shrink below the full `white-space: nowrap` title width, so the ellipsis never shows.
F2: The change replaced the `4em` left padding on `.small-action-desc` with `0 1.5%` and made `.small-action` a flex row. The description box now starts after the 45px avatar, so the untouched mobile `margin-left: -40px` pushes the custom message out of the box into the avatar column, and a flex item no longer wraps text around the float.
